prediction: At least one source and merge separates both held donor halves. The positive group agrees along that fitted coordinate. Verified donor friction events provide an affine geometry for subsequent preservation.

rule: At each computationally registered source and merge, split positive and negative donor IDs into two deterministic stratified folds.
